authorityBoundary.repositoryAuthority: This artefact records package and workspace boundaries for app-surface implementation. It does not define product behaviour.
authorityBoundary.linearAuthority: Linear tracks work only and does not define USF semantic authority.
authorityBoundary.runtimeAuthority: This issue may create package manifests and placeholder metadata only. Runtime code remains owned by later implementation issues.
authorityBoundary.packageAuthority: No package dependency is added by this artefact. Future dependency additions require package-managed exact versions, lockfile updates, and repository-owned rationale.
